headline: Plan outdoor time for tomorrow 2 PM to 5 PM
details: Average PM2.5 across Delhi sample points is about 151 ug/m3, roughly 6.9 cigarettes a day of exposure. Smoke from 8 fire hotspots may reach Delhi in about 9 hours (estimate).
actions: Do outdoor walks or exercise around 2 PM to 5 PM.
